source_note: 把积分或求和对象视为一个计数函数并展开
english_source_note: Treating Sums or Integrals as Counting Functions
callout_id: 把积分或求和对象视为一个计数函数并展开#2
statement_en: Compute the Laplace transform of $\lfloor x\rfloor$, that is, evaluate the parameter-dependent integral $$I_s:= \int_0^{\infty} \lfloor x\rfloor e^{-sx}\,dx.$$
key_techniques: rewrite $\lfloor x\rfloor$ as a counting function
prerequisites: Tonelli or Fubini type interchange of sum and integral
callout_body: 计算函数$\lfloor x\rfloor$的Laplace变换，即求含参数积分$$I_s:= \int_0^{\infty} \lfloor x\rfloor e^{-sx}\,dx$$
